blocks.text: Why Reston Office Cleaning Carries a Security Premium

Reston is one of the densest defense, government contracting, and cloud-infrastructure office markets in the country, stretched along the Dulles Toll Road and the Silver Line. Local janitorial pricing sits at 1.20x national benchmarks. The janitor median wage reference is about $19.80 per hour, and contractors bill standard and light specialty labor at $42–$72 per hour. But wages alone do not explain Reston bids. The Northern Virginia defense and tech corridor demands cleared or vetted personnel and Class A finish standards, and both add cost that never appears in a generic national rate card.

Tenants handling controlled unclassified information or operating secure spaces often require janitors to pass enhanced background checks, sign facility NDAs, and work under escort in restricted zones. Vendors who can supply that workforce carry higher payroll, longer hiring cycles, and lower turnover tolerance, so they price accordingly.
Reston Budget Table at 3x and 5x Weekly Service

Most Reston tenants with full-time on-site staff choose three or five nights per week. The table below applies the 1.20x multiplier to national per-visit rates and converts to monthly costs using 4.33 weeks per month: 13 visits at a 0.95 frequency multiplier for 3x weekly and 21.65 visits at 0.90 for daily weekday service.

blocks.text: These are routine-scope figures. Escorted access into secure areas typically adds 8–15% to labor hours, and tenants that require vendor personnel with active clearances should expect premiums beyond that, since cleared janitorial staff are scarce and command higher wages.
Reston Town Center, Dulles Corridor, and Sunset Hills

Reston Town Center is the walkable, mixed-use core with trophy office towers above retail and restaurants. Buildings here enforce strict Class A standards: spotless stainless elevator cabs, streak-free glass, and hardwood or stone lobbies that must look perfect at 7 a.m. The Dulles Corridor, especially around the Wiehle-Reston East and Reston Town Center Metro stations, holds large single-tenant defense and tech buildings where secure floors and SCIF-adjacent spaces are common. Sunset Hills Road has a mix of older mid-rise office and newer redevelopments, often with more VCT and carpet and slightly more flexible access rules.

items: Reston Town Center towers: budget for daily lobby hardwood and stone care; a residue-free neutral cleaner like Bona Pro Series protects urethane finishes on wood without leaving a dull film.
Dulles Corridor secure tenants: define which rooms crews may never enter and who removes trash from those rooms (often tenant staff using shred bins).
Sunset Hills mid-rises: these buildings often allow unescorted after-hours access, so per-visit labor is closer to the low end of the table.
All submarkets: Metro-adjacent buildings see higher foot traffic and need entry matting extraction more often during wet spring months.

blocks.title: Background Checks and Facility NDAs
blocks.text: Cleared contractor background checks and strict facility NDA rules are standard in Reston. Put the screening standard in the RFP (for example, a seven-year criminal history check, E-Verify, and tenant-specific badging), state who pays for credentialing, and require the vendor to notify you within 24 hours of any staff change on your account. Unvetted substitute workers are the most common security breach in janitorial contracts.
Disinfection and Restroom Standards for Class A Tenants

Reston tenants expect hospital-grade results without residue. A 1:256 neutral quaternary disinfectant such as Diversey Virex II 256 gives crews one product for restroom fixtures, partitions, and floors, which simplifies HazCom training and reduces the number of Safety Data Sheets on-site. For phones, keyboards' surrounding surfaces, and conference tables between meetings, an EPA-registered aerosol like Lysol Professional disinfectant spray lets day porters treat touchpoints quickly. Ask bidders to list every chemical, its dilution ratio, and the required dwell time, because skipping dwell time is how disinfection claims fail.

Restroom service adds $18–$36 per restroom per visit after the 1.20x factor. In buildings with large multi-stall cores on every floor, that line item can exceed the base square-foot charge for a small tenant, so confirm whether restrooms are landlord or tenant responsibility under your lease.
How to Run a Clean Reston RFP

items.name: Classify your spaces
items.text: Mark open areas, restricted zones, and no-entry rooms on the floor plan so bidders can price escort time accurately.

items.name: Set the vetting standard
items.text: Specify background checks, NDAs, and badging requirements up front and ask each vendor to describe its screening process and turnover rate.

items.name: Require the full COI package
items.text: Ask for general liability, auto, umbrella, Virginia workers' compensation, and a fidelity bond, with your company and landlord as additional insureds.

items.name: Define finish standards
items.text: Describe Class A expectations for glass, stainless, and lobby floors, and attach an inspection checklist the vendor's supervisor must complete weekly.

items.name: Normalize and compare
items.text: Convert every bid to a monthly figure using 4.33 weeks per month and separate base service from add-ons before comparing.

faqs.q: How much does office cleaning cost in Reston, VA?
faqs.a: A 5,000 sq ft Reston office typically pays $540–$900 per visit, or about $6,669–$11,115 per month at three nights per week and $10,522–$17,536 at five nights. These figures apply Reston's 1.20x multiplier and 4.33 weeks per month.

faqs.q: Do Reston janitors need security clearances?
faqs.a: Most do not hold federal clearances, but many tenants require enhanced background checks, facility NDAs, and escorted access in restricted areas. Tenants that require cleared personnel should expect significant premiums because that labor pool is small.

faqs.q: What insurance should a Reston cleaning vendor provide?
faqs.a: Request a COI with general liability of at least $1 million per occurrence, auto liability, an umbrella policy for Class A towers, Virginia workers' compensation, and a fidelity or janitorial bond covering employee theft, naming you and your landlord as additional insureds.

faqs.q: How do I keep cleaning crews out of secure rooms?
faqs.a: Mark no-entry rooms on the scope document, configure access control so janitorial badges do not open those doors, and assign trash and shred removal from secure spaces to tenant staff. Require the vendor to log entry and exit times for every shift.

faqs.q: What OSHA requirements apply to Reston janitorial contracts?
faqs.a: The vendor must maintain an OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens exposure control plan for restroom work and a Hazard Communication program with labeled containers and Safety Data Sheets. Ask to review both before signing, along with training records for the crew assigned to your site.
